title: Kummer Refinement
statement: For an actual normalized global Kummer chart on S, a refinement-natural family assigns to every scheme morphism g:S′→S an actual KummerGlobalChart over g composed with the boundary-to-base map, with the same root geometry and coefficient object. Its comparison equals the exact Cartesian pullback of the original comparison, including the associativity transport and canonical point-pullback comparison. Thus each restriction retains the augmented nerve and actual counit normalization, for identities and composites as well. Built from [def-sfb-kummer-invariant-scalar-map], [def-sfb-kummer-local-source], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], [def-sfb-kummer-global-chart].
